statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient loss of consciousness
The patient has brief neurological deficits suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
There is concern for a cardiogenic etiology
The service is to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias that may be contributing to the syncopal events
The service is to evaluate for potential cerebral hypoperfusion
The diagnosis codes are R55 and G45.9
The service was denied because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the date of service
The denial reason code is CO-197
